findings.message: The elements draw 48.0 A hot at 240 V. At +5 % supply voltage (ANSI C84.1 Range A) that is 50.4 A, and 52.8 A while the wire is cold, against the 48 A continuous limit. Kiln makers rate kilns the same way.

The tool chose 2 elements of 9 AWG wire (2.91 mm): the fewest elements that work, each with the thickest wire whose coil fits its groove. Kanthal recommends wire of 3 mm or more for the longest life in grooves. No number of elements in the left, right and back walls fits wire that thick, because its coils would be longer than the grooves. Expect to replace these elements sooner.
Electrical work must follow your local code and be checked by a licensed electrician. These results are engineering guidance, not an approved design.
